questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Inheritance interacts with environmental conditions to shape organisms.
options: Inheritance interacts with environmental conditions to shape organisms.
Every visible trait is controlled by exactly one gene.
Children are exact copies of their parents.
Any difference between plants proves a genetic difference.
